messages:
Nadia P: Heads-up: ran a shadow bring-up for candidate v3-int4 vs anchor v2.9-fp16 on the longdoc summarization slice in staging. Overall rouge_mean slightly improved but p95 MRR and hallucination tail worsened.
Rohit G: can you paste the slice stats and sample counts?
Nadia P: quick summary: rouge_mean +0.5, mrr_p95 -1.9 pts, halluc_longtail +1.2ppt. Problem concentrated on docs > 8k tokens.
Nadia P: ```anchor: v2.9-fp16
candidate: v3-int4
rouge_mean: 0.603 -> 0.608
mrr_p95: 0.855 -> 0.836
halluc_longtail: 0.017 -> 0.029
samples_longtail: 780
```
Maya L: that's a sharp longtail move. Reproducible?
Nadia P: reran with larger sampling window (48h), same direction; p95 mrr delta ~ -1.8 to -2.0. Halluc rate stable.
Deploy-bot: shadow-run 6122 completed, artifacts at /runs/6122.
Rohit G: possible culprits: quantized attention mat rounding, caching/warmup mismatch, or sampling bias in long docs. Did you check per-token loss drift?
Nadia P: per-token loss shows slight late-context drift; kv warmup hit-rate comparable. No tokenization/truncation issues found.
Sam T: what's the staged-canary gating config we used? Need thresholds and smoothing behavior.
Nadia P: current staging policy: window=6h, metrics=[mrr_p95,halluc_longtail,rouge_mean], thresholds: mrr_drop=0.015, halluc_inc=0.02, smoothing=3-bucket majority, contiguous_required=2.
Maya L: with noisy longtail, that majority rule can be noisy. Suggest anchored-EWMA smoothing for fragile slices and stronger hysteresis for low-count slices.
Rohit G: agree. Propose an atomic rollout rule we can insert to avoid a promotion until we validate tail stability.
Nadia P: draft rule (text): name: longdoc_tail_guard; triggers: mrr_p95 delta_lt 0.015 with ewma_hl_6h; halluc_longtail delta_gt 0.01; sample_guard when_count_lt 500 multiplier 1.25; hysteresis contiguous_buckets 3 cooldown 20m; action immediate-fallback + page on-call.
Maya L: also add a softpage if halluc_longtail > 0.02 regardless of other metrics. And record anchor-drift (embedding cosine) to separate covariate shift from quant error.
Rohit G: we should stash a reproducible failure artifact: IDs of failing samples, per-sample diffs, attention heatmaps for 20 examples. SPoF: attach small repro script.
Nadia P: will open PR to add the rule to staged-canary, enable ewma smoothing for the longdoc slice, and re-run shadow for 72h. I'll attach a 100-sample failure set and a repro script.
Deploy-bot: created issue ML-8310: "longdoc int4 tail guard + ewma smoothing" assigned to @Nadia P.
Sam T: please ping infra to rate-limit promotion until rule lands.
Nadia P: will hold the promote until extended shadow completes and rule is live. If rule triggers, auto-fallback and we debug quant rounding in attention matrices.
Rohit G: fine by me. I'll review the PR this afternoon.
Maya L: I can review after 5pm PT. :thumbsup:
